question: In 2022, Arjun Singh Dhurve was honoured with the Padma Shri Award for his contribution in which of the following Indian folk-dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baiga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baiga:**
 
• Arjun Singh Dhurve received the Padma Shri in 2022 for his contributions to the Baiga folk dance.
 
• He is a prominent exponent of the Baiga tribal dance form, which is native to Madhya Pradesh.
 
• He has dedicated his life to preserving and promoting the traditional Baiga culture and performing arts.
 
• His work has helped to bring recognition to the unique cultural heritage of the Baiga community.
 
• The Baiga dance form is an important part of the tribal traditions of central India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laho:**
 
• Laho is a folk dance form from Meghalaya, primarily associated with the Pnar tribe.
 
• It is a celebratory dance performed during festivals.
 
• It is not the dance form associated with Arjun Singh Dhurve.
 
• It is a very colorful dance.
 
• It is performed by both men and women.
 
• **Bihu:**
 
• Bihu is a popular folk dance form from Assam.
 
• It is performed during the Bihu festival, which marks the Assamese New Year.
 
• It is a vibrant and energetic dance form.
 
• It is not the dance form associated with Arjun Singh Dhurve.
 
• It is an important part of Assamese culture.
 
• **Chhau:**
 
• Chhau is a classical dance form with martial and folk traditions, originating in eastern India (primarily Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal).
 
• It involves masked dancers and elaborate costumes.
 
• It is known for its dynamic movements and storytelling.
 
• It is not the dance form associated with Arjun Singh Dhurve.
 
• There are three main styles of Chhau dance.
